family_title_en: Sort soft and hard g words and soft and hard c words

stages.ix_title: Sort soft and hard g words and soft and hard c words

what_to_do.en: Tap hard c, soft c, hard g, or soft g.
what_to_do.ko: hard c, soft c, hard g, soft g 중에서 하나를 누르세요.

roots: Use these four choices in this order on every item: hard c, soft c, hard g, soft g.
Set answer_index to 0 for hard c, 1 for soft c, 2 for hard g, and 3 for soft g.
Make the stem one lowercase real spelling from the roots list or allowed_extra_words. Skip typos on the list, and do not add words around the target.
Pick a word with one clear c or one clear g. Never use a word that has both a c choice and a g choice.
Do not use ch or ck spellings. Do not use circle, council, soccer, science, special, social, or official.
Skip language, access, accessories, financial, piggy, bigger, hugged, wiggles, and getting. They do not follow one clean rule.

Hard sounds like the c in cake or the g in game. Soft sounds like the c in ice or the g in page. A, o, u, or a consonant after the letter keeps it hard. E, i, or y after it makes it soft, except the hard g words named in tier 3. A c or g with no letter after it is hard, as in dog and music.
Two of the same letter are allowed only when both are the same kind, as in picnic, where both c letters are hard.
Keep the four bins about even. For tier 3, the tempting wrong bin is the other sound of the same letter.
Use kid words about home, school, food, pets, play, family, or weather. No brands and no real names.
If you add media, use one lemma note for that word. Do not invent an mp3 name and do not describe a picture in the stem.
Use explain_key hard_c, soft_c, hard_g, or soft_g, except hard_g_odd and soft_g_y where the tier 3 rule says so.

tier_rules.1: One-syllable words with an obvious pattern. Hard c before a, o, u, or a consonant, as in cake, cat, cup, cow, and crab. Hard g before a, o, u, or a consonant, as in game, go, and gold, or a hard g at the end, as in dog and frog. Soft c before e, as in ice, face, nice, and mice. Soft g before e, as in page, large, age, and bridge.
tier_rules.2: Longer kid words, usually two syllables, with the letter sometimes in the middle. Hard c: cookie, color, crayon. Hard g: garden, grandma. Soft c: pencil, city, center, cereal. Soft g: orange, message. The vowel rule still decides.
tier_rules.3: Near misses only. These keep a hard g before e or i and use explain_key hard_g_odd: girl, girls, gift, give, given, get, begin, geese, together. These are soft because y follows g and use soft_g_y: gym, energy. Music ends with a hard c, and both c letters in picnic are hard.

hard_c.en: This c is hard. It sounds like the c in cat and cake.
hard_c.ko: 이 c는 강한 c입니다. cat과 cake의 c와 같은 소리입니다.

soft_c.en: This c is soft. It sounds like the c in ice and city.
soft_c.ko: 이 c는 부드러운 c입니다. ice와 city의 c와 같은 소리입니다.

hard_g.en: This g is hard. It sounds like the g in game and dog.
hard_g.ko: 이 g는 강한 g입니다. game과 dog의 g와 같은 소리입니다.

soft_g.en: This g is soft. It sounds like the g in page and orange.
soft_g.ko: 이 g는 부드러운 g입니다. page와 orange의 g와 같은 소리입니다.

hard_g_odd.en: This g stays hard. It sounds like the g in game, not page.
hard_g_odd.ko: 이 g는 그대로 강한 g입니다. game의 g와 같고 page의 g와 다릅니다.

soft_g_y.en: This g is soft. A g before y can sound like the g in page.
soft_g_y.ko: 이 g는 부드러운 g입니다. g 다음에 y가 오면 page의 g와 같습니다.
